author: Inside Edition
description: Colby Livingston from California's Orange County Fire Authority had an unusual Easter morning, when his team got a call about a wild animal in need. A massive deer was stuck in a fence opening about half its size. Because the deer was scared and fighting their rescue efforts, Colby decided to hold him like he'd hold a dog. That calmed the deer down and the team was able to remove him safely. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: California Firefighters Help Massive Deer Stuck In Fence On Easter Morning

author: Inside Edition
description: The man accused of being the Gilgo Beach serial killer has pled guilty in charges stemming from the murder of seven women between 1993 and 2011. He also admitted killing another woman in a Long Island courtroom Wednesday. Rex Heuermann has been in custody since July 2023 and originally pleaded not guilty to multiple charges of first and second degree murder, however, he has now changed his plea to guilty ahead of a trial that was slated for September. He will be sentenced in June.
title: Gilgo Beach Serial Killer Rex Heuermann Pleads Guilty to Murdering 7 Women, Admits to 8th Victim

author: Inside Edition
description: Florida deputies saved a woman after her vehicle drove off road and into a retention pond on April 5. The Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office says 911 dispatchers received a phone call from a woman who said she had lost control of her vehicle, causing it to enter the body of water. When the driver called 911, she told the dispatcher she could not swim, deputies arrived within seconds and broke the window of the car in order to pull the woman to safety.
title: Bodycam Footage Shows Florida Deputies Saving Woman After Car is Submerged in Water

author: Inside Edition
description: Another day, another post on Truth Social by the president, but his message was much different from recent messages. This time, President Trump began with, "A big day for World Peace!" announcing a ceasefire agreement between the US and Iran just after midnight April 8. Just a day earlier, Trump made threats to bomb the country's infrastructure, saying, "a whole civilization will die." Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Trump Declares 'A Big Day For World Peace' After 2-Week Ceasefire Agreement

author: Inside Edition
description: A jar of Nutella tried to steal the show on the Artemis II as the crew was on their way to making history. The hazelnut spread was seen floating through the Orion spacecraft while the astronauts were hard at work. On April 7, the Artemis II crew officially made history as they took a trip around the far side of the moon. They reached a distance of 252,756 miles from Earth. The previous record set by Apollo 13 in 1970 was 248,655 miles. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Jar Of Nutella Steals The Show As Artemis II Crew Makes History

author: Inside Edition
description: Ye, the artist formally known as Kanye West, has been banned from visiting Great Britain to headline the Wireless Festival this summer after backlash over his past antisemitic, racist and pro-Nazi statements and songs, the event's organizers announced Tuesday. Due to his removal, the annual London based music festival has been cancelled. In a statement, Ye said, "I've been following the conversation around Wireless and I want to address it directly. My only goal is to come to London and present a show of change, bringing unity, peace, and love through my music."
title: Ye, Artist Formally Known as Kanye West, Banned from Britain
